name: Ashland
notes: Adopts the current ORSC including R327.4 within the City. Oregon BCD also lists Ashland.

name: Deschutes County
notes: Ordinance 2026-002 was considered for second reading and adoption on 28 January 2026. The current County page makes R327 mandatory throughout the unincorporated county for new ORSC dwellings and accessory structures from 1 April 2026, with ordinary additions, repairs, remodels, manufactured dwellings, commercial-code buildings, and named small detached accessory structures excluded.

name: Grants Pass
sourceTitle: City of Grants Pass Municipal Code Title 9, §§9.04.010 and 9.04.200
notes: Current code adopts ORSC Section R327 and requires new construction to conform to the City Building Code. Oregon BCD lists Grants Pass, and the city ordinance index dates Ordinance 21-5805 to 2 June 2021. The retrieved sources do not establish the effective date or decide the local hazard-zone and project trigger.

name: Sisters
notes: Council minutes record adoption of Ordinance 545 on 19 November 2025. City code applies ORSC R327 throughout Sisters, with Deschutes County Building Safety administering it. Current City and County permit pages make it mandatory for new ORSC dwellings and accessory structures from 1 April 2026. Oregon BCD also lists Sisters.

name: Bend
notes: Current code establishes all Bend city limits as the WUI Hazard Zone and applies ORSC R327 throughout that area. The ordinance index dates NS-2552 to 15 April 2026 and the code records May 2026 codification, but the opened sources do not establish its exact effective date. Oregon BCD's current adopter list omits Bend as of 27 August 2026.
